description: D2: boss_engaged for enemy.stormcaller (he wakes: a blow, or a giant climbing into his pools) switches to Harrok's set (music.boss_harrok: the giants' duel - the Stormcaller has no set of his own, decision D2-8), after its intro stinger; boss_defeated plays the victory stinger, and an escape (boss_disengaged left) returns the music to the zone.
